summary: A 14x14-foot cab in Lemhi County, Idaho, dated to 1926 or the 1930s, last staffed in 2000 and now abandoned, reached by a poor hike-in trail.

facts.design: 14x14 ft cab: 4A per the register, R-4 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

access.note: Reached on foot on National Forest land. No sign marks the route, and no source says the cab is open to visitors or rented.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in. The trail crosses a stream more than 15 times and a visitor calls it poor; a good map and GPS are advised.

events.note: Two-story log cabin per Idaho Fire Lookouts; the sources do not say whether it is the same building as the 1926 cab
Decade only (1930s): 14x14 R-4 cab on a stone basement per Idaho Fire Lookouts; firelookout.com and a second hobbyist site also say 1930s
Earliest staffing record in these sources: two men stationed that season, one an emergency worker
Newspaper item: lookout manned the previous week; supplies carried up in 1953
Register visit-report comment: manned July 3 to September 17
First fire found July 4, per the 1966 register comment

notes_for_editor: Build date conflicts: register 1926 (4A cab) vs Idaho Fire Lookouts 1923 two-story log cabin plus a 1930s R-4 cab, and firelookout.com 1930s. Cab type also conflicts (4A vs R-4). Forest name conflicts (Salmon-Challis vs Salmon). Distance from Salmon: a 1959 newspaper item places it about 20 miles west; firelookout.com says 27 miles WNW (not used in story). Latest condition evidence is the 2009 register visit report; no 2020s status was found. The record kind two_story appears to come from a firelookout.org '2-Story cab' label and was not independently checked. No photos added: the visible photos are credited to Luke Channer with no licence stated.
